name: Episode Stitcher
description: Arranges 3-13 scenes into a 5-act episode of the Fracture City animated show. Generates connective transitions, infers themes, composes title and logline, plots the tension arc, tracks character continuity. Consumes scene.moment.v1; produces episode.outline.v1 ready for animation production.

inputs.description: Individual scenes — selected from the saved scene library and arranged into act structure.

outputs.description: Full episode record: title, logline, themes, ordered scenes with transitions, tension arc, character continuity, runtime estimate.

author: Avner Media
